description: This file declares functions related to parsing WPA supplicant events and building WPA credentials. It serves as a header defining interfaces for WPA/WPS credential handling in a Wi-Fi management context.

methods.name: wpaSup_parseWpsReceiveCredentialsEvt
methods.description: Parses received WPS credentials event data and populates credential structure.

methods.name: wpaSupp_buildWpsCredentials
methods.description: Builds WPS credentials from access point data into a data buffer.
